blocks.text: Agar do ajza wala mixture pani ya kisi aur solvent mein solid ka solution ho to use simple distillation se alag kiya ja sakta hai. Samandari pani peene ke qabil nahi kyunke yeh pani mein bohat se halne wale inorganic compounds ka mixture hai; inhen hatane ke liye samandari pani distil kiya jata hai. Fractional distillation distillation ki ek aur qism hai, jo do aise liquids alag karne ke liye hai jo ek doosre mein halne wale ya milne wale (miscible) hon, maslan distillation flask mein garam kiya gaya pani aur ethyl alcohol ka mixture.

blocks.prompt: Simple aur fractional distillation mein kya farq hai, aur rozmarra zindagi mein fractional distillation kahan istemal hoti hai (Quick Check 15.3)?
blocks.explanation: Simple distillation ghair-udne wale hal shuda solids se solvent ubal kar condense karti hai; fractional distillation taqreeban 25 degrees C ke farq wale boiling points ke do milne wale liquids alag karne ke liye fractionating column istemal karti hai. Fractional distillation khaam petroleum ko petrol, diesel, kerosene aur furnace oil mein, aur khameer shuda sharab se ethanol alag karti hai.

items: Simple distillation: solid ke solution se solvent (samandari pani se peene ka pani). Fractional distillation: do milne wale liquids (pani aur ethanol).
